extracted.intended_audience: mathematics researchers considering submitting to or reading the Annales scientifiques de l'École normale supérieure
extracted.subtask_short: submitting math research to Annales ENS
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for authors and readers about the Annales scientifiques de l'École normale supérieure: its scope, selection process, language policy, and the expository standards expected of submitted mathematical research articles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope: fields of mathematics
rubrics_metrics.description: Nowadays, the Annales are open to all fields of mathematics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal accepts work from any area of mathematics — submissions should fall within mathematical research broadly construed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mathematical substantiality
rubrics_metrics.description: The Editorial Board, with the help of referees, selects articles which are mathematically very substantial.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions are expected to make significant mathematical contributions (depth, novelty, or importance). The phrase 'mathematically very substantial' indicates a high bar for originality and depth in results or methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity and rigour of exposition
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal insists on maintaining a tradition of clarity and rigour in the exposition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts should present arguments with precise, rigorous proofs and clear exposition. Readability and careful presentation are considered important alongside technical content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection process: editorial board and referees
rubrics_metrics.description: The Editorial Board, with the help of referees, selects articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitted papers are evaluated by the journal's editorial board and external referees; authors should expect peer review and decisions based on referee reports and editorial judgment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language policy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal publishes in English and French — submissions may be prepared in either language according to the journal's accepted languages policy.
